schema:alternativeHeadline:
A color Grand Canyon postcard and a Trail Picture purchase slip are mounted above two photographs of travelers at a viewpoint and canyon scenery.

Written text (transcribed as written):
Printed caption below upper-left postcard: “H-1527. NORTH FROM PIMA POINT, GRAND CANYON NATIONAL PARK, ARIZONA. © AQ-8”
Printed and handwritten trail-picture card: “YOUR TRAIL PICTURE Is No. 77 Dated aug-14-25 PRICE 50 CENTS THE COPY On Sale ONLY at KOLB BROS. Studio Located at Toll Gate on Bright Angel Trail, be- low the Rim, 100 yards west of Bright Angel Hotel. (Not the Lookout). Mail Orders Promptly Filled. Kolb Brothers, Grand Canyon, Arizona”
Handwritten between rows: “9-12-13-14-15-25”
Powell memorial inscription: “·1869· JOHN C. SUMNER WALTER H. POWELL G. Y. BRADLEY WILLIAM H. HAWKINS ANDREW HALL ·1872· A. H. THOMPSON F. S. DELLENBAUGH JOHN K. HILLERS STEPHEN V. JONES W. CLEMENT POWELL ANDREW HATTAN ERECTED BY THE CONGRESS OF THE UNITED STATES TO MAJOR JOHN WESLEY POWELL FIRST EXPLORER OF THE GRAND CANYON WHO DESCENDED THE RIVER WITH HIS PARTY IN ROWBOATS TRAVERSING THE GORGE BENEATH THIS POINT AUGUST 17, 1869 AND AGAIN SEPTEMBER 1, 1872”
